description: Lists the projects this credential can act on. A project is one site or brand under the account, and every widget, lead, campaign and sequence belongs to one. Pass an id as the project argument on any tool to run that call in it, or as the x-fnlowl-project header (remote) or FNLOWL_PROJECT (local) to set the connection's default; with neither, tools read across the whole account. The row with current true is the one this call was already scoped to; no row is current when the reads cover the whole account.
name: list_projects
title: List projects
